scope_note: Correspondence, articles, business records and lecture notes of journalist, educator and abolitionist Mary Ann Shadd Cary, founder of The Provincial Freeman. The guide says the records were transcribed during Douglass Day in 2023.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

scope_note: Records of Amherstburg historian and genealogist Alvin McCurdy, including family genealogy and records of Black churches and organizations. The guide calls it the Archives' largest source on Black history in Ontario and says it was added to the Canada Memory of the World Register in July 2021.

curated.access_note: Digitized records can be viewed through Wikimedia Commons and a digital exhibit; the full fonds is consulted at the Archives.

scope_note: Personal and association records of sociologist, human rights specialist and Black historian Daniel G. Hill, including his work with the Ontario Black History Society. Some access restrictions apply.

curated.access_note: The Archives created a digital exhibit from the fonds. Some access restrictions apply, so contact the Archives.

fonds_title: Black Canadian photographs (Multicultural History Society of Ontario fonds)
scope_note: Photographs of Black Canadian individuals, families, recreation, church life in African Methodist Episcopal churches, military service and work, mostly in Ontario and also in Saint John, New Brunswick.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

scope_note: An album kept by singer and actress Phyllis Marshall, an early Canadian television star and a pioneer among Black Canadian performers, with clippings, photographs and mementos.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

scope_note: Material on the life and work of Black history and heritage activist Wilma Morrison, who helped preserve and recognize Black history in the Niagara Region.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

fonds_title: Letter of Tom Elice [Ellis] to Mary Warner
scope_note: A one-page letter from Tom Elice (or Ellis), a freedom seeker from Kentucky, written from Chatham, Ontario, after a journey on the Underground Railroad.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items. The guide notes an online exhibit examines this letter.

scope_note: Material documenting Ian Jones's work as a steelpan and calypso player, arranger, composer and educator, including the Ontario Steelpan Association.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

scope_note: A run of Spear: Canada's Truth and Soul Magazine, launched in Toronto in 1971, covering Black middle-class life in Toronto.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

fonds_title: Department of Education subject files (schools with Black students)
scope_note: Correspondence about staffing and running schools with Black students in Ontario, including separate schools in Colchester, Harwich and Sandwich.

curated.access_note: In most cases records are viewed at the Archives; contact them in advance to request items.

fonds_title: Abolitionist newspapers on microfilm: Provincial Freeman and Voice of the Fugitive
scope_note: Microfilm reels of two Black abolitionist newspapers. The guide also points to digitized copies in the Our Digital World collection of Abolitionist Newspapers of the 1850s.
ref_code: N 40 (Provincial Freeman); N 33 (Voice of the Fugitive)

curated.access_note: Microfilm usually does not need to be ordered in advance. Libraries with interloan services may borrow reels; digitized copies exist elsewhere.

fonds_title: Congress of Black Women of Canada, Toronto Chapter fonds
scope_note: Records of the Toronto chapter formed in 1983 as a forum for Black women's needs and concerns, including material on the documentary Children Are Not the Problem. Some access restrictions apply.

curated.access_note: Some access restrictions apply. Contact the Archives before visiting.
